dialogue.text: Waa inuu mar u fahmo iyo kuwa dhowrsan.
dialogue.translation: He must only understand and be supported by those around him.

dialogue.text: Hadana, hodan waa qayb si fiican oo barwaaqo.
dialogue.translation: Also, the teacher is a significant part of success.

dialogue.text: Haddii gudbiyeyaal iyo hodan dhowrsan si fiican, waxaa noqon barwaaqo.
dialogue.translation: If the student and teacher support each other well, success will come.
